method: Same as hand_gt_a.json: ground-truth features of gt_j1.json located by eye in 3x-3.5x crops (gtmont.py, 20 px tick grid) centred on the coarse prediction of the 11 preliminary pairs; px = predicted centre + read offset. Building symbols on this sheet are 4-8 px squares; clusters of symbols under one printed owner name are read at the cluster centre with a larger sigma. Warren GCP features (bridges, road crossings, Leister house) have modern ground truth (NAIP/TIGER/DEM, maps/gcps/warren.json).
